description: Defines a class 'tlvMic' for a TLV (Type-Length-Value) structure with associated fields, types, comments, and nested types, primarily used for message integrity and protocol representations in the wfa_map namespace.

classes.name: tlvMic
classes.description: A class representing a TLV structure for message integrity, including fields for type, length, flags, integrity transmission counter, source MAC address, and MIC.

classes.name: sFlags
classes.description: A structure defining bit fields for flags used within the 'tlvMic' class, including 'ieee1905_gtk_key_id', 'mic_version', and 'reserved'.

classes.name: eMicVersion
classes.description: An enum representing MIC version types, with values 'VERSION_1' and 'RESERVED'.
